name: Prototype: festival crowd space in two chapter states
body: One world file with the festival; chapter 2 (walk in holding hands, the crowd pulls you apart, call, climb a crate, find her at the stall she liked) and chapter 5 (same space and crowd; call, nothing answers, go to the stall, the level ends when you stop calling and stand still). Dean's open questions are picked at the doc's leaning and each is one constant.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-21 before any code, from Dean's 'Gameplay Direction: Finding Her' doc (searching as the core mechanic, not a platformer).

acceptance_criteria: Both states play from the Prototypes menu
Ch2 can be completed by finding her
Ch5 ends when the player stops calling and stands still
